subject: german
promptStrong: Give me an exam-style {board} {level} {subject} question on {lo}, then mark my answer against the mark scheme.
promptWeak: Explain {lo} for {board} {level} {subject} simply, with a clear example and the most common mistake students make.

questions.q: How do you say 'Smoking is harmful to health'?
options: Rauchen ist schädlich für die Gesundheit
Rauchen ist gut für die Gesundheit
questions.explain: 'Schädlich' = 'harmful' and 'für die Gesundheit' = 'for health', so this is correct.
'Gesund' means 'healthy', so 'gesund leben' = 'to live healthily'.
In German, 'Silvester' is New Year's Eve (31 December). Christmas Eve is 'Heiligabend'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'I go swimming twice a week'?
options: Ich gehe zweimal pro Monat schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe einmal pro Woche schwimmen
Ich gehe zweimal pro Woche tanzen
questions.explain: 'Zweimal pro Woche' = 'twice a week' and 'schwimmen' = 'to swim'.
'Die Erkältung' means 'a cold' (the illness); 'sich erkälten' = 'to catch a cold'.
'Die Spritze' means 'an injection/jab'.

questions.q: How do you say 'In my free time I often play chess'?
options: In meiner Freizeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Freizeit höre ich oft Musik
In meiner Arbeit spiele ich oft Schach
In meiner Freizeit spiele ich nie Schach
questions.explain: 'Die Freizeit' = 'free time/leisure' and 'Schach spielen' = 'to play chess'.
'Die Mahlzeit' means 'the meal'.

questions.q: Which sentence means 'You must avoid fatty food'?
questions.explain: 'Man muss' = 'one must' and 'vermeiden' = 'to avoid', so this means 'You must avoid fatty food'.
'Der Schiedsrichter' means 'the referee/umpire' in sport.

questions.q: How do you say 'You should drink enough water'?
questions.explain: 'Genug' = 'enough' and 'trinken' = 'to drink'; 'wenig' (little) is the trap.
'Der Zuschauer' means 'the spectator/viewer' (someone watching).
'Der Knochen' means 'the bone'.
'Das Rauchen' means 'smoking' (the activity). 'Der Raum' (room) is a near-miss distractor.
'Die Freizeit' means 'free time / leisure time'.

questions.q: How do you say 'I do exercise to stay fit'?
options: Ich esse Pommes, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu sein
Ich treibe Sport, um fit zu bleiben
Ich treibe Sport, um müde zu werden
questions.explain: 'Sport treiben' = 'to do sport/exercise' and 'um fit zu bleiben' = 'in order to stay fit'.
'Spannend' means 'exciting/gripping', e.g. of a film or book.

questions.q: How do you say 'I play football'?
questions.explain: 'Fußball spielen' = 'to play football'. 'Klavier spielen' would be 'to play piano'.

questions.q: What does 'Ich treffe mich mit Freunden' mean?
questions.explain: 'Sich treffen mit' means 'to meet up with', so this is 'I meet up with friends'.
'Das Schlagzeug' means 'the drum kit' (from 'schlagen' = to hit).
'Angeln' means 'to fish/go angling' (from 'die Angel' = fishing rod).
